naive_baseline.name: Naive Baseline (Persistence)
naive_baseline.description: Assumes future filings remain constant at the last observed historical level.

moving_average.name: Moving Average (Window=2)
moving_average.description: Average of the two most recent historical observation periods.

exponential_smoothing.name: Holt Exponential Smoothing
exponential_smoothing.description: Models level and linear trend with exponential weighting on recent periods.

poisson_glm.name: Poisson Count GLM
poisson_glm.description: Count regression modeling filings as a function of time trend and court infrastructure capacity.

arima.name: ARIMA(1, 1, 0)
arima.description: Autoregressive integrated moving average capturing serial dependency.

future_projections.scope_caveat: JUDICIAL WORKLOAD CAVEAT: This aggregate workload forecast estimates macro court system caseload to assist judicial administration. It CANNOT predict the outcome, duration, or probability of an individual person's case.
